Sette: centre the micro ring first, dial in with macro, fine-tune with micro.

grinders.notes: Espresso-first grinder; Baratza gives no French press setting for the Sette.

setting.dialReading: Stepless dial marked 0-50 around the top; past 50 an unmarked section continues coarser.
setting.entryHint: Type the dial number at the pointer, e.g. 15.

rangeSources.note: Niche Zero: espresso 5-20, moka 20-30, AeroPress 30-35, V60 35-45, French press 45+. Niche Duo: espresso 0-10, moka 10-20, AeroPress 20-30, V60 30-45, French press 45+. Stepless.
Espresso typically lands between 10 and 20.

grinders.notes: Niche says '45+' for French press; 50 is the last printed number. Unit-to-unit calibration varies.

setting.dialReading: Stepless dial; Niche says the numbers are a guide. Clockwise is finer. Ships with separate espresso and filter burr sets.
setting.entryHint: Type the dial number at the pointer and note which burr set is fitted.

rangeSources.note: Niche Zero: espresso 5-20, moka 20-30, AeroPress 30-35, V60 35-45, French press 45+. Niche Duo: espresso 0-10, moka 10-20, AeroPress 20-30, V60 30-45, French press 45+. Stepless.

grinders.notes: Niche gives French press as '45+'; 50 is the top of the app's range, not a Niche number. Max 50 is a UI bound. Numbers shift with the burr set and how it was zeroed.

setting.dialReading: Stepless collar printed 0-90 around one turn. Lower is finer; find your own zero (burrs just touching) first.
setting.entryHint: Type the collar number at the pointer, e.g. 12.

rangeSources.note: Aggregator chart built from the site's own micron estimates and reader feedback, not the manufacturer. V60 band 23-53.
Espresso about 5-15, V60 about 50-80.

grinders.notes: Also sold as MiiCoffee, G-IOTA and Solo. Sources disagree on filter numbers; zero first.

setting.dialReading: Stepless collar with printed numbers. Lower is finer; zero at burr touch first.
setting.entryHint: Type the collar number at the pointer.

rangeSources.note: Aggregator chart built from the site's own micron estimates and reader feedback, not the manufacturer. V60 band 32-63.

grinders.notes: Aggregator ranges only.

setting.dialReading: Stepless collar with printed numbers. Lower is finer; zero at burr touch first.
setting.entryHint: Type the collar number at the pointer.

rangeSources.note: Aggregator chart built from the site's own micron estimates and reader feedback, not the manufacturer. V60 band 34-67.

grinders.notes: Aggregator ranges only.

setting.dialReading: Stepless micrometric knob; the printed numbers are reference marks only. Espresso sits inside the first turn from burr contact.
setting.entryHint: Type the number at the marker on the first turn, e.g. 2.5. For coarser brews several turns out, log turns in the notes.

rangeSources.note: Aggregator chart built from the site's own micron estimates and reader feedback, not the manufacturer. Rotation+number notation (1+4 = one turn plus 4); only the first-turn espresso band 0-3.5 converts to one number.
Infinitely adjustable; numbers are reference points.

grinders.notes: Filter settings need multiple turns, which one number can't hold without knowing the marks per turn; Eureka does not publish that.

setting.dialReading: Stepless micrometric knob like the Specialita; numbers are reference marks.
setting.entryHint: Type the number at the marker and keep it consistent.

rangeSources.note: Mignon family: stepless, numbers are reference points only.

grinders.notes: No published or aggregator chart found; dial in espresso by shot time and taste. Range max is a UI bound.

setting.dialReading: Stepless dial numbered 0-16 on current units (older ones read 1-11 and use a different scale).
setting.entryHint: Type the dial number at the pointer, e.g. 9.5.

rangeSources.note: Aggregator chart built from the site's own micron estimates and reader feedback, not the manufacturer. 0-16 dial; V60 band 5.7-13.3. The EK43 S page gives the same numbers.

grinders.notes: Cafe and competition workhorse. Calibration and burr alignment move these numbers a lot.

setting.dialReading: Stepless dial printed 1-35, fine to coarse.
setting.entryHint: Type the dial number, e.g. 3 for espresso, 20 for filter.

rangeSources.note: Espresso 01-05, caffe creme 05-15, filter 15-25, French press >25.
Aggregator chart built from the site's own micron estimates and reader feedback, not the manufacturer. Used for moka, AeroPress and cold brew only. V60 band 9.5-24.

grinders.notes: Espresso, filter and French press are Mahlkonig's own brackets.

setting.dialReading: Stepless worm-drive adjustment; no published numbered scale that maps to brew methods.
setting.entryHint: Log whatever mark you use consistently; dial espresso in by shot time.

rangeSources.note: Commercial on-demand espresso grinder; no home brew-method chart found.

grinders.notes: Included for cafe-trained users. No chart found; range is a UI bound.

setting.dialReading: Stepless dial with printed numbers; zero must be set per unit.
setting.entryHint: Type the dial number after zeroing, e.g. 2.5.

rangeSources.note: Owners after re-zeroing: light-roast espresso around 2, washed coffees 2.2-2.8, AeroPress Go about 5. Some units could not reach espresso without zeroing.

grinders.notes: Forum numbers only; Ditting publishes no home chart. Max is a UI bound.

setting.dialReading: Stepless dial. Settings are read as an offset from your unit's burr-lock (touch) number.
setting.entryHint: Type the dial number minus your burr-lock number, e.g. burr lock at 1.0 and dial at 6.0 → 5.0.

rangeSources.note: Aggregator chart built from the site's own micron estimates and reader feedback, not the manufacturer. Numbers above the burr-lock position; V60 band 8-14.

grinders.notes: Aggregator ranges only.

setting.dialReading: Stepless collar numbered 0-9 with 10 lines between numbers; read number.line (3.4 = number 3, fourth line). Locked so it can't go below 0.
setting.entryHint: Type number.line; on the second turn add 10 (number 2 on the second turn → 12).

rangeSources.note: Collar 0-9 with 10 lines between numbers; stepless.
Aggregator chart built from the site's own micron estimates and reader feedback, not the manufacturer. Dial settings; V60 band 1.6-4.5.

grinders.notes: Burr choice (Mizen Omni, SSP, etc.) changes the numbers a lot.

setting.dialReading: Stepless; charts count the dots on the adjustment ring from zero.
setting.entryHint: Type dots from zero, e.g. 60.

rangeSources.note: Aggregator chart built from the site's own micron estimates and reader feedback, not the manufacturer. Moonshine burrs, dots from zero; V60 band 40-70. The Obsidian burr page differs.

grinders.notes: Aggregator ranges only.

setting.dialReading: 41 stepped settings on the bean-container ring, finer toward 1.
setting.entryHint: Type the number on the ring, e.g. 20.

rangeSources.note: Espresso 3-7, AeroPress 14-26, pour over 14-28, filter (batch) 22-32, French press 30-38, steep/cold brew 39-41.

grinders.notes: Manufacturer chart.

setting.dialReading: Stepless dial; charts count printed numbers from zero.
setting.entryHint: Type the dial number, e.g. 6.

rangeSources.note: Aggregator chart built from the site's own micron estimates and reader feedback, not the manufacturer. Gen 2; V60 band 3.7-8.4. Gen 1 has its own page.

grinders.notes: Aggregator ranges only.

setting.dialReading: Stepless dial graduated in microns from zero (burr contact).
setting.entryHint: Type the micron reading, e.g. 650.

rangeSources.note: Aggregator chart built from the site's own micron estimates and reader feedback, not the manufacturer. Micron ranges, which match this dial's own unit. V60 band 400-700.

grinders.notes: Because the dial reads microns, the generic micron bands apply directly.

setting.dialReading: Stepless ring nut numbered 0-9 per turn with small steps between; charts read number.step (3.2 = number 3, second step). Clockwise is finer.
setting.entryHint: Type number.step; on a second turn add 10.

rangeSources.note: 58 mm burrs, stepless ring nut, dial 0-9; printed zones: M-Modal from moka/AeroPress to cold brew tower, B-Modal adds espresso and ibrik.

Aggregator chart built from the site's own micron estimates and reader feedback, not the manufacturer. M-Modal burrs; V60 band 2.3-6.2. Its espresso 0-2.0 was left out because the manual puts espresso only on the B-Modal burr.

grinders.notes: Ranges are for M-Modal (filter) burrs. B-Modal owners: espresso sits on the first turn per the manual's zone diagram.

setting.dialReading: 15 numbered settings with micro steps between them; charts read number.step (4.1 = setting 4, first micro step).
setting.entryHint: Type number.step, e.g. 8.2.

rangeSources.note: Aggregator chart built from the site's own micron estimates and reader feedback, not the manufacturer. V60 band 4.1-8.2.

grinders.notes: Espresso only realistically with pressurised baskets.

setting.dialReading: 60 numbered steps shown on the screen, finer toward 1. The upper burr can be moved internally to shift the whole scale.
setting.entryHint: Type the number on the display, e.g. 12.

rangeSources.note: 60 grind settings; stainless steel conical burrs (no diameter given).
Coffee chart: espresso 1-30 (start at 12 with single-wall baskets, 30 with dual-wall), drip 31-45, filter/percolator 46-54, French press 55-60. The upper burr is removable and adjustable.

Aggregator chart built from the site's own micron estimates and reader feedback, not the manufacturer. Used for Turkish, moka, AeroPress and siphon only. Its espresso 1-18, V60 21-48 and French press 48-60 differ from Breville's chart.

grinders.notes: Espresso, pour over (Breville's drip and filter columns) and French press are Breville's own bands; Turkish, moka, AeroPress and siphon are aggregator estimates. Moving the internal upper burr shifts every number.

setting.dialReading: Stepped collar, 55 settings, finer toward 0.
setting.entryHint: Type the collar number, e.g. 8.

rangeSources.note: Aggregator chart built from the site's own micron estimates and reader feedback, not the manufacturer. V60 band 13-30.

grinders.notes: Zero varies between units; many need recalibration.

setting.dialReading: Numbered collar, stepped at about 6 microns per notch; can be converted to stepless.
setting.entryHint: Type the collar number.

rangeSources.note: 64 mm I200D or I189D burrs; every notch is about 6 microns; switchable stepped/stepless.

grinders.notes: No published brew-method chart found; dial in by taste. Max is a UI bound.

setting.dialReading: 16 numbered settings, finer toward 1.
setting.entryHint: Type the dial number.

rangeSources.note: Aggregator chart built from the site's own micron estimates and reader feedback, not the manufacturer. V60 band 4-8. Its espresso 1-3 was left out: not an espresso grinder.

grinders.notes: Budget conical burr grinder.

setting.dialReading: 18-position dial, finer toward 1.
setting.entryHint: Type the dial position.

rangeSources.note: Aggregator chart built from the site's own micron estimates and reader feedback, not the manufacturer. Its finest setting is about 420 microns, so no espresso. V60 band 1-4.

grinders.notes: Very common budget flat-burr grinder; fines-heavy.
